captures_chronological.label: initial-owned-h3-state
captures_chronological.visible_observation: Original WeftForge main window: accepted-h1-002-redo-r5 filename, R5, one piece, zero seams, 43 vertices, PAUSED. The paired AX says unchanged relative to the initial getApp baseline.

captures_chronological.label: hole-eleven-current-edge-inspector
captures_chronological.visible_observation: Hole #11 selected from Scene. Inspector displays owner #2, curve #16, P0 #12 (0.060000, 0.120000), P3 #13 (0.080000, 0.240000), and free hole boundary.

captures_chronological.label: point-twelve-u-focused
captures_chronological.visible_observation: Current pointer focus is in point #12 U field containing .06; field focus/selection is visible. R5 remains.

captures_chronological.label: point-twelve-u-literal-draft
captures_chronological.visible_observation: Literal .08 draft is visible in focused U field after one select-all and type. R5/P0 label still show precommit values.

captures_chronological.label: point-twelve-r6-one-tab-committed
captures_chronological.visible_observation: The sole Tab commits R6, dirty marker, 46 vertices, P0 #12 (0.080000, 0.120000), and 120.000 mm curve length. Focus moves to V .12; no V edit occurs.

captures_chronological.label: file-menu-before-fresh-save-as
captures_chronological.visible_observation: File menu is visible with Save As route; underlying project remains R6.

captures_chronological.label: fresh-native-save-as-chooser
captures_chronological.visible_observation: Native compact Save chooser appears with default garment name and Documents folder.

captures_chronological.label: save-as-owned-folder-prompt
captures_chronological.visible_observation: Go to Folder sheet opens. Its selected remembered path is the old S1 work directory; no save or project load is performed there.

captures_chronological.label: save-as-owned-h3-work-folder-literal
captures_chronological.visible_observation: Exact H3 work directory has replaced the remembered path in the Go to Folder field; screenshot and AX retain the intended owned path.

captures_chronological.label: save-as-in-owned-h3-work-folder
captures_chronological.visible_observation: Native Save chooser is now in H3 work folder.

captures_chronological.label: save-as-exact-h3-basename-enabled-save
captures_chronological.visible_observation: One Name setValue has supplied hole-r240-h3.work.weftforge; current AX gives full exact basename and Save is enabled. JPEG pointer covers part of the name.

captures_chronological.label: fresh-h3-r6-project-clean-saved
captures_chronological.visible_observation: Chooser closes after the sole Save. Main window shows clean H3 basename, R6, PAUSED and atomic-save status.

captures_chronological.label: file-menu-before-obj-export
captures_chronological.visible_observation: File menu before OBJ route. A prior menu hover is incidental; next input selects Export OBJ.

captures_chronological.label: fresh-native-obj-export-chooser
captures_chronological.visible_observation: Native OBJ Save chooser opens with garment.obj in current work folder.

captures_chronological.label: obj-owned-export-folder-prompt
captures_chronological.visible_observation: OBJ Go to Folder sheet shows the currently selected H3 work path.

captures_chronological.label: obj-owned-export-folder-literal
captures_chronological.visible_observation: H3 exports directory literal is present after one replacement.

captures_chronological.label: obj-in-owned-h3-export-folder
captures_chronological.visible_observation: OBJ chooser is now in the owned H3 exports folder.

captures_chronological.label: obj-exact-basename-enabled-save
captures_chronological.visible_observation: One Name setValue supplies hole-r6.obj, with enabled Save.

captures_chronological.label: native-obj-export-clean-observation
captures_chronological.visible_observation: Chooser closes after one Save. Main window remains clean R6/PAUSED and reports Exported OBJ cloth surface in metres; internal annotations stay in .weftforge.

captures_chronological.label: file-menu-before-svg-export
captures_chronological.visible_observation: File menu before SVG route; underlying R6 remains unchanged.

captures_chronological.label: fresh-native-svg-export-chooser
captures_chronological.visible_observation: Native SVG Save chooser opens with garment.svg in exports folder.

captures_chronological.label: svg-owned-export-folder-prompt
captures_chronological.visible_observation: SVG Go to Folder sheet shows selected H3 exports path and retained exports-folder suggestion.

captures_chronological.label: svg-owned-export-folder-literal
captures_chronological.visible_observation: Exact H3 exports path is re-entered. AX reports unchanged tree with focused full path; original JPEG confirms the sheet remains visible.

captures_chronological.label: svg-in-owned-h3-export-folder
captures_chronological.visible_observation: SVG chooser is in H3 exports folder.

captures_chronological.label: svg-exact-basename-enabled-save
captures_chronological.visible_observation: One Name setValue supplies hole-r6.svg with enabled Save.

captures_chronological.label: native-svg-export-clean-observation
captures_chronological.visible_observation: Chooser closes after one Save. Main window remains clean R6/PAUSED and reports compound SVG boundaries including holes in millimetres, unsupported hole-aware reimport, and native-only internal annotations.

captures_chronological.label: file-menu-before-dxf-refusal
captures_chronological.visible_observation: File menu before intentional DXF-refusal route.

captures_chronological.label: native-dxf-refusal-chooser
captures_chronological.visible_observation: Native DXF Save chooser opens with garment.dxf in exports folder.

captures_chronological.label: dxf-owned-export-folder-prompt
captures_chronological.visible_observation: DXF Go to Folder sheet displays selected H3 exports path and exports-folder suggestion.

captures_chronological.label: dxf-owned-export-folder-literal
captures_chronological.visible_observation: Exact H3 exports path has been re-entered. Unchanged AX includes focused full path; JPEG confirms the folder sheet.

captures_chronological.label: dxf-in-owned-h3-export-folder
captures_chronological.visible_observation: DXF chooser is in H3 exports folder.

captures_chronological.label: dxf-exact-sentinel-basename-enabled-save
captures_chronological.visible_observation: One Name setValue supplies existing hole-r6.dxf with enabled Save.

captures_chronological.label: dxf-existing-destination-replace-prompt
captures_chronological.visible_observation: After one Save, native replacement prompt names existing hole-r6.dxf and offers Replace. This is the planned refusal fixture path.

captures_chronological.label: native-dxf-intentional-refusal-clean-observation
captures_chronological.visible_observation: After one Replace, chooser is gone and main window remains clean R6/PAUSED. Visible status: DXF v1 export does not support holes; save native v5 or export SVG/OBJ instead.
